bindings.requirement: Require one explicit visible three-option decision after the turn-0 identity receipt; retain ask until response, keep Advance hard-blocked, and forbid hidden, inferred, Historical-mode, harness, retry, or save/load selection.

Assert every whole-event turn-0 delta and clock: flags, dimensions, receipt and fired turn, notifications, runtime causality, ask 0.97 recruitment for 52 turns, allow 0.95 recruitment for 52 turns plus 104-turn paramilitary_rear_clearance priority, and deny no-modifier behavior; any split, duplicate, omission, or clock mismatch voids this GO.

Fork one serialized pre-response state with identical seed and control; at first Advance prove deny has no request/deployment, ask has the corresponding pending requests without spawn/capture, and allow reaches exactly Bukvik Gornji 2 and Obadi through existing detection/spawn/advance/civilian/war-crime writers.

Use frozen n94 only as a comparator for candidate inputs, ordering, modes, and the two target OSIDs; do not require whole-state byte identity between player and no-player lanes and do not describe allow as Historical parity, recovery, optimization, or recommended play.

Limit acceptance to pre-first-Advance capability and exact immediate branch semantics; make no inference about all seven January differences, turn-39 or turn-188 equality, score 707, calibration fitness, or baseline adoption.

Keep n91, n92, n93, n94, n95, reference and pin files, protected controls, and all telemetry byte-identical; change no event data, headless/bot behavior, sweep/target/control/capture/scoring logic, threshold, or acceptance floor.

Write and observe the focused RED fixture before production changes. Cap the three-file Vitest command at three minutes; pre-change may fail only the new availability expectation. After implementation rerun it once with the same cap and require green, then run nonincremental noEmit once with a three-minute cap and require exit 0. Stop on timeout or any unexpected failure before retry or expansion.

After all seats and independent implementation review, separately plan one exact-source/package native attempt through first Advance only; stop at turn 1 and stop on any target, receipt, effect-clock, provenance, protection, or telemetry failure. No automatic retry, turn-39 run, 188-week run, score claim, or adoption follows from this verdict.

Treat the currently running clean b371adc3e full suite as evidence only for that unchanged source. Preserve it, do not relabel it as timing-candidate validation, and run any required candidate broad suite only after cheap gates under a new explicit cost and stop plan.
Obtain independent Historian, Engine/systems, and Red-team GO in addition to existing Game Design and UI/UX reviews; any BLOCK, split, or unmet binding returns to the owner before implementation.
